PROFILE

PROJECTS
Sentiment Analysis System using DistilBERT Fine-Tuning
Fine-tuned DistilBERT for 3-class sentiment classification using PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers with a web UI.
StormStage AI: An SLM-Based Intelligent Agricultural Question Answering System
Developed an SLM-based agricultural Q&A system helps farmers by providing quick answers to queries on crops, pests,
fertilizers, and irrigation. It uses a lightweight language model trained on agriculture data to deliver accurate, fast, and cost-
effective guidance, especially useful in rural areas with limited resources.
Sign Language to Text Converter using MediaPipe
Build a real-time sign language recognition system using MediaPipe hand tracking and a CNN model for gesture
classification. Implemented word prediction, and text-to-speech output for assistive communication.
Online Fuel Delivery and Mechanical Assistance
A web-based application that enables users to order fuel anywhere at anytime. And it is platform where the user can also
get mechanical assistance from experts if they face any problems with their vehicle.
TimeSnap-chrome extension
Developed a Chrome extension that enables timestamp-based note-taking on YouTube videos, featuring real-time capture,
searchable storage, and CSV export using Chrome APIs.
INTERNSHIPS
Infosys Springboard Internship(Remote) 02/2026 – 04/2026
Developed a digital site survey tool for Internet Service Provider to automate manual field data
collection for network deployment. from Infosys Spring Board Virtual Internship.
